# Commands desktop build, graph task-worktree, and review UI updates

`removeGraphBranchRef()` verifies `refs/heads/<branch>` still names the selected hash before `git branch -D -- <branch>`. Electron dialogs hide the active native browser via `overlay(open)` and restore it on close; use `navigationHistory.canGoBack()/canGoForward()/goBack()/goForward()`, not manual history indexes. [Task 2]

Scope: console.
